component.name: Craft Hub
component.summary: Install, update and uninstall the Crafting Apps

description.p: Craft Hub is a Creative-Cloud-style manager for the ArtCraft Crafting Apps: PhotoCraft, VectorCraft, DesignCraft, LightCraft, FilmCraft, EffectCraft, PDFCraft and ArtCraft.

ul.li: One click to install, update, uninstall or open each app
Downloads are verified against each release's checksums
Apps with updates are sorted to the top, with an Update all button
Clean uninstall, optionally including each app's settings

description.p: Craft Hub is an independent project and isn't affiliated with the ArtCraft team or Adobe Inc.
